name: get_order
description: Returns one order by its ID: status, items, totals and shipping address. Use when the user gives an order number such as ORD-10293.

order_id.description: The order ID, for example ORD-10293.

name: search_orders
description: Finds a customer's orders by email address, newest first, at most 50. Use when the user does not know the order number.

customer_email.description: The email address the orders were placed with.

status.description: Only return orders with this status.

limit.description: How many orders to return, 1 to 50.
